changes.rationale: Polish the review-log tooling and package the investigate brief for the hosts, without adding a gate. task-artifact verdict now requires --model and --findings (order --reviewer --model --findings --notes) and stores them as optional row fields that are skipped when absent, so committed logs keep parsing and are not rewritten; schema_version stays 1, and an older xtask refuses a log holding a new row (one-way compatibility). Any other verdict shape gets the full usage. task-artifact next treats only a page's own rows past the committed log as pending, so the page just reviewed gets the commit step. The investigate skill for Claude Code and Codex carries docs/skills/investigate.md verbatim after its frontmatter; DOC009 keeps the body equal to that GEPA seed, and DOC010 refuses an unquoted ': ' in a skill description, which strict YAML rejects (investigate and add-product-command now quote theirs). Limits: --model's 64 limit counts bytes; if a GEPA suite's task repositories are made from this template, the host skill sits beside every candidate in trial workspaces.
